name: YouTube Short
strategic_objective: Fast discovery, reach expansion, and top-of-funnel growth through short-form vertical video.

tone: Fast, direct, energetic, and hook-driven. Less explanatory, more immediate.
copywriting_rules: The first 1–2 seconds of the video must communicate the hook visually or verbally. The title should reinforce the main idea or curiosity. Description is optional and minimal.
Title: short hook or statement. Optional description: 1–2 short lines of context or CTA.
Deliver the hook, context, and clarity immediately for sound-off viewing.
Hook text in the first second
Sync text with speech and cuts
Use topic and niche hashtags. Avoid unrelated trend tags.
Tag collaborators only if they appear in the Short.

hard_constraints: Slow intros with logos before the hook
Trying to cover multiple topics in one Short
Reposting horizontal clips without vertical optimization
Clickbait hooks unrelated to the actual content
